request: Metadata.Clone returns an independent copy: changing an element of a value slice in the original, or appending to it, never changes the clone, and changes to the clone never reach the original.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(metadata): ensure Clone creates deep copy of slices (#3767)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > metadata/metadata_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestMetadata_CloneDeepCopy)$' ./metadata >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
